info.name: Arogio Health API
info.description:
Production-ready Postman Collection for the Arogio Health Backend API (/api/v1).

Includes complete request definitions, automated token management test scripts, and full Success / Error response examples for every endpoint.

variable.description: Default fallback baseUrl if no environment is selected
JWT access token populated automatically upon login or registration
One-time rotating refresh token populated automatically
Google OAuth ID token received by the mobile/web client

item.name: Health & Readiness
item.description: Endpoints for infrastructure liveness and dependency readiness probes.

request.description: Check if the API process is running and able to handle incoming requests.
Check if all critical dependencies (PostgreSQL database pool) are connected and ready to accept queries.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Registration, login, Google OAuth, token rotation, and session logout endpoints.

request.description: Register a new user account with email, password (min 12 chars with upper, lower, number), and optional health metrics (height & weight).

request.description: Rotate the one-time refresh token. The submitted refresh token is invalidated, and a new token pair is returned. Attempting to reuse an expired or rotated token revokes the entire token family.

response.name: 401 Unauthorized - Invalid or Expired Refresh Token

request.description: Revoke the active refresh session in the database so the refresh token cannot be rotated again.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Malformed Token

item.name: Users
item.description: Authenticated profile retrieval and update endpoints.

request.description: Fetch the authenticated user's profile details using the Bearer access token.

Update permitted current-user profile fields: fullName (2-100 chars), username (3-30 lowercase alphanumeric + underscores), height (with unit cm/in), and weight (with unit kg/lb). BMI is automatically re-calculated.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - No Fields Provided
400 Bad Request - Invalid Username Format

request.description: Create initial profile setup. Requires the collection Bearer token; retries preserve an existing profile.
